# Managed Python data-runtime lock for CPython 3.13 (cp313) -- universal: one hashed lock
# serves the win_amd64 bundle and the manylinux x86_64 bundle. Only these wheel artifacts
# may enter a bundle; a pin whose marker is false for the target platform (tzdata is
# win32-only) is absent from that platform's wheelhouse and the checker evaluates markers
# per contract platform.
#
# Regenerate with uv 0.11.19 (delete the output first: `uv pip compile -o <existing file>`
# reuses that file's pins and hash lists):
#   uv pip compile --universal --python-version 3.13 --generate-hashes --no-header
#     -c <constraints: the current pins, one name==version per line>
#     -o requirements-python-runtime-lock.txt <input: config/python-runtime-bundle-lock*.json
#     runtime_packages + bootstrap_packages, one per line>
# The constraints file also holds `python-dateutil<3`: 3.x requires tzdata on every platform,
# which would drop tzdata's win32-only marker and ship it in the Linux bundle.
--only-binary=:all:
